A little rigor goes a long way

Measure the finish.
Not the first draft.

Baseline − (prompting + waiting + review + rework)
= net time saved

  1. Define “done” first. Use equivalent scope and the same quality check for the baseline and assisted attempt. Choose a narrow, repeatable task.
  2. Log the full attempt. Count each minute once. Include failed attempts and their cost. A negative result means AI took longer.
  3. Keep quality beside speed. Net time saved includes every attempt, even quality failures. A faster failed result is not a usable deliverable.
  4. Repeat before you generalize. Learning, task difficulty, and order affect results. Try multiple comparable tasks and alternate methods. This log is descriptive, not a causal study or a forecast.
How the optional value estimate works

Estimated value = (net minutes saved ÷ 60 × your hourly value) − tool cost. Break-even hourly value = tool cost ÷ hours saved, available only when hours saved are positive. Neither calculation adjusts for output quality, unpaid work, opportunity cost, or whether you can actually use the saved time. Both apply only to the trials recorded here.
